note: Top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, search box, 'New project', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'To do list', 'Help', user avatar

Project sidebar navigation -- renders: 'Project information', 'Repository', 'Commits', 'Branches', 'Tags', 'Contributors', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'Pipelines', 'Deployments', 'Packages', 'Infrastructure', 'Monitor', 'Analytics', 'Wiki', 'Snippets', 'Settings'; excludes the project name header which is user-defined
